title: Structured Programming: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B.

parts.text: Explain why the use of comments in C programs is generally considered to be good programming practice.
Briefly describe the following.
abort()
rand()
qsort()
abs()
Explain what a data type is and list examples of data types.
Describe the importance of the C standard library.
Illustrate using C code how a pointer is defined and assigned values.
Explain how a structure is different from a union.

The straight line method of computing the yearly turnover of a company is given by: Turnover = (Sales - Expenses) / No. of months. Write a program to determine the profit per month when the sales, months of operation and the annual expenditure are availed.

An election is contested by 8 candidates. The candidates are numbered 1 to 8 and the voting is done by marking the candidate number on the ballot paper. Write a program to enable voting for the 8 candidates by clicking a radio button. No one should be allowed to vote for more than 1 candidate. Write code to facilitate the above.
Describe three types of errors encountered in C programming. Give an example in each category.

Given that: if (day == 1) printf("Monday"); else if (day == 2) printf("Tue"); else if (day == 3) printf("Wednesday"); else printf("It's not Sunday yet"); rewrite the above program in switch-case form.
Illustrate the usage of the sizeof() operator.
Define storage class. Explain how any two of the storage classes are used in C.
Convert the following expression into C language: (y^4 * 5) - (x^4).
With a valid example, give the relationship between the following terms.
An operator
An operand
An expression
What is operator precedence?
A programmer encountered the following error messages on compiling a program: (i) Stack overflow, (ii) Statement missing. Kindly explain how to debug the above errors.
Give three features of a structure.
Give the meaning of the following declarations.
char Fname[16];
int num_emp;
double intake, BBIT;
char response;
i) Define the term operator. ii) Describe with examples four relational operators.
Write a function to calculate the volume of a cylinder. The function accepts two arguments representing the radius and height.
Explain three types of escape sequences. Illustrate in a program to show their usage in the C language.
Describe the four basic data types in C while giving the memory requirement and format specifier for each data type.
Declare a pointer to an array.

Using an array, write a program that prompts the user to input their bio data for the date/month/year of birth and computes the age based on the current year. The program should display the year of birth, age, birthday in terms of dd/mm/yy and a birthday congratulation message on the eventual date.
